writing.title: A damaged online order
writing.prompt:
You recently ordered an item from an online shop, but when it arrived it was damaged.

Write a letter to the customer services manager. In your letter

• give details of what you ordered and when
• describe the damage
• say what you would like the company to do

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Sir or Madam,
outline: Mở thư: nêu mục đích – phàn nàn về đơn hàng bị hỏng
Đoạn 1: món hàng, ngày đặt, mã đơn, ngày nhận
Đoạn 2: mô tả hư hỏng (kèm ảnh), không dùng được
Đoạn 3: yêu cầu đổi hàng mới hoặc hoàn tiền + thời hạn
Kết: Yours faithfully + họ tên
vocab: I am writing to complain about
Tôi viết thư để phàn nàn về
I am writing to complain about an order I received.
I would like a replacement to be sent.
Alternatively, I would accept a full refund.
Please reply at your earliest convenience.
writing.sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about an item I ordered from your website, which arrived in a damaged condition.

On 3 March, I ordered a white ceramic table lamp (order number BK-20431), which was delivered five days later. Although the outer box appeared to be in good condition, when I unpacked the lamp I discovered that its base was badly cracked and that one side of the lampshade was torn. As a result, the lamp cannot be used safely. I have taken several photographs of the damage, which I have attached to this letter.

I was very disappointed, as I had chosen the lamp as a gift for a friend's new flat. I would therefore be grateful if you could send me a replacement as soon as possible, and arrange for the damaged lamp to be collected from my address at no extra cost. If a replacement is not available, I would like a full refund to be paid to my credit card.

I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.

Yours faithfully,
Minh Tran

writing.title: Broken street lights in your area
writing.prompt:
Several street lights in the road where you live have not been working for some time.

Write a letter to your local council. In your letter

• describe the problem
• explain how it is affecting local residents
• suggest what the council should do

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Sir or Madam,
outline: Mở thư: báo cáo đèn đường hỏng ở phố mình
Đoạn 1: số đèn hỏng, vị trí, bao lâu
Đoạn 2: ảnh hưởng – nguy hiểm cho người đi bộ, trẻ em, trộm cắp, tai nạn
Đoạn 3: đề nghị sửa ngay + kiểm tra định kỳ, kênh báo hỏng online
Kết: Yours faithfully
vocab: I would like to draw your attention to a problem in our street.
The darkness poses a risk to pedestrians.
The council should carry out repairs urgently.
writing.sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to draw your attention to a problem with the street lighting in Willow Road, where I have lived for the past six years.

For almost two months, five of the eight street lights between the post office and the primary school have not been working. Despite the fact that several neighbours have reported the problem by telephone, no repairs have been carried out so far.

This situation is causing considerable concern among local residents. Since it now gets dark before six o'clock, many people, including children returning from after-school activities, have to walk along a section of road that is almost completely dark. Last week an elderly neighbour tripped over an uneven paving stone and injured her wrist, and two cars parked in the street have recently been broken into.

I would therefore urge the council to repair the lights as soon as possible. It would also be helpful if the street lighting in the area could be inspected regularly, and if residents could report faults online so that they are dealt with more quickly.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Yours faithfully,
Minh Tran

writing.title: Applying for a part-time job at a museum
writing.prompt:
You have seen an advertisement for a part-time job at a museum in your city.

Write a letter to the museum manager. In your letter

• say which job you are applying for and where you saw the advertisement
• describe your relevant experience and skills
• explain when you are available for an interview

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Sir or Madam,
outline: Mở thư: ứng tuyển vị trí nào, thấy quảng cáo ở đâu
Đoạn 1: kinh nghiệm liên quan (hướng dẫn khách, bán hàng), kỹ năng (ngoại ngữ, giao tiếp)
Đoạn 2: lý do phù hợp/quan tâm đến bảo tàng
Đoạn 3: thời gian có thể phỏng vấn, đính kèm CV
Kết: Yours faithfully
vocab: I would like to apply for the position of weekend guide.
I have relevant experience in customer service.
I am fluent in English and Korean.
I have attached a copy of my CV.
writing.sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to apply for the position of part-time weekend guide at the City History Museum, which I saw advertised on your website last week.

I am currently in my final year at university, where I am studying history, so I have a strong interest in the period covered by your main exhibition. For the past two summers, I have worked as a tour guide for a local travel company, leading groups of up to twenty visitors around the old town. This experience has taught me how to present information in an engaging way and how to deal politely with questions and complaints. In addition, I speak English fluently and have a good working knowledge of Korean, which I believe would be useful given the number of international visitors to the museum.

I have attached a copy of my CV, together with a reference from my previous employer. I would be available for an interview on any weekday afternoon after 2 pm, and I could start work at the beginning of next month.

Thank you for considering my application.

Yours faithfully,
Minh Tran

writing.title: Enquiring about an evening course
writing.prompt:
You would like to join an evening course at a local college.

Write a letter to the course administrator. In your letter

• say which course you are interested in and why
• ask for some information about the course
• explain a special requirement you have

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Sir or Madam,
outline: Mở thư: quan tâm khoá học buổi tối nào
Đoạn 1: lý do (công việc cần kỹ năng)
Đoạn 2: câu hỏi – lịch học, học phí, trả góp, chứng chỉ, trình độ đầu vào
Đoạn 3: yêu cầu đặc biệt – vắng 2 buổi vì công tác, có thể học bù/tài liệu online?
Kết: Yours faithfully
vocab: I am interested in your evening course in graphic design.
I would be grateful if you could
Tôi sẽ rất biết ơn nếu quý vị có thể
I would be grateful if you could send me the timetable.
Could you tell me the tuition fees?
Is it possible to pay in instalments?
writing.sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to enquire about the evening course in graphic design that your college is offering from next January.

I work in the marketing department of a small company, and I am increasingly expected to design leaflets and social media posts myself. Although I have taught myself some basic skills, I feel that a structured course would help me to work more professionally and confidently.

I would be grateful if you could provide some further information. Firstly, could you tell me how many evenings a week the classes take place and at what time they finish? Secondly, I would like to know the total cost of the course and whether it is possible to pay the tuition fees in instalments. I would also like to know whether students receive a certificate at the end of the course.

Finally, I should mention that my job requires me to travel abroad for one week in February, so I would have to miss two classes. Could you let me know whether recordings or materials from missed lessons would be available online?

I look forward to your reply.

Yours faithfully,
Minh Tran

writing.title: Luggage lost on a flight
writing.prompt:
You recently travelled by plane, but your suitcase did not arrive at your destination.

Write a letter to the airline. In your letter

• give details of your flight
• describe your suitcase and its contents
• say what you want the airline to do

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Sir or Madam,
outline: Mở thư: báo mất hành lý
Đoạn 1: chuyến bay (số hiệu, ngày, chặng), đã báo tại sân bay, mã hồ sơ
Đoạn 2: mô tả vali (màu, cỡ, đặc điểm) và đồ bên trong
Đoạn 3: yêu cầu tìm và giao tận nhà; bồi thường chi phí mua đồ thiết yếu
Kết: Yours faithfully
vocab: The reference number for my report is HAN-2287.
My suitcase did not appear at baggage claim.
I had to buy some essential items.
I would like you to reimburse these costs.
writing.sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing regarding my suitcase, which failed to arrive at my destination after a recent flight with your airline.

On 14 June, I flew from Hanoi to Singapore on flight SA 512, which landed at 3.40 pm. After waiting at baggage claim for more than an hour, I reported the missing suitcase at your service desk, where I was given the reference number HAN-2287. Unfortunately, I have not received any news since then.

The suitcase is a large dark-blue hard case with four wheels and a yellow strap around the middle. My name and phone number are on a label attached to the handle. Inside were most of my clothes for the trip, a pair of black leather shoes, a hairdryer and several gifts for my colleagues.

I would be grateful if you could trace the suitcase as a matter of urgency and deliver it to my hotel, the address of which is given below. In the meantime, I have had to buy some essential items, such as clothes and toiletries, and I would like you to reimburse these costs. I have kept all the receipts.

Yours faithfully,
Minh Tran

writing.title: Plans to close a local library
writing.prompt:
The local newspaper has reported that the council plans to close the public library in your area.

Write a letter to the editor of the newspaper. In your letter

• explain how you use the library
• say why you disagree with the plan
• suggest an alternative to closing the library

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Sir or Madam,
outline: Mở thư: phản hồi bài báo về kế hoạch đóng cửa thư viện
Đoạn 1: bản thân dùng thư viện thế nào
Đoạn 2: vì sao phản đối – nơi học tập yên tĩnh, internet miễn phí, người già, trẻ em
Đoạn 3: giải pháp thay thế – mở cửa ít giờ hơn, tình nguyện viên, cho thuê phòng, quán cà phê
Kết: Yours faithfully
vocab: I am writing in response to your article.
I strongly oppose the council's plan.
The library is a lifeline for elderly residents.
The library could generate income by renting out rooms.
writing.sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing in response to your article of 2 May, which reported that the council intends to close Greenhill Library next year in order to save money.

I have been a member of the library for over ten years. I borrow books there almost every week, and when I was preparing for my university entrance exams, I studied in its quiet reading room every evening, as my home was too noisy.

I strongly oppose the council's plan. The library is not simply a place to borrow books; it is one of the few free public spaces left in our neighbourhood. Many elderly residents rely on it to read newspapers and meet other people, while families who cannot afford computers use its free internet to apply for jobs or complete homework. For these people, the library is a lifeline.

Rather than closing the library, the council could reduce its opening hours, involve volunteers in running it, or generate income by renting out its meeting rooms to local groups and opening a small café.

I hope the council will reconsider its decision.

Yours faithfully,
Minh Tran

writing.title: Cancelling a gym membership
writing.prompt:
You have a one-year membership at a sports centre, but you are moving to another city for work.

Write a letter to the manager of the sports centre. In your letter

• give details of your membership
• explain why you need to cancel it
• ask for a refund and explain how it should be paid

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Sir or Madam,
outline: Mở thư: yêu cầu huỷ hội viên
Đoạn 1: loại thẻ, số hội viên, ngày bắt đầu, đã trả trước 12 tháng
Đoạn 2: lý do – chuyển công tác, không còn trung tâm gần nơi ở mới
Đoạn 3: đề nghị hoàn tiền phần còn lại, chuyển khoản; sẵn sàng nộp giấy tờ chứng minh
Kết: Yours faithfully
vocab: I paid the full annual fee in advance.
I have been transferred to our office in Da Nang.
I would like a refund for the remaining months.
writing.sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to request the cancellation of my membership at Riverside Sports Centre and a refund of the unused part of my fee.

I joined the centre on 1 February this year on a one-year membership (number 40217), which includes use of the gym, the swimming pool and all group classes. At the time of joining, I paid the full annual fee of 6,000,000 dong in advance.

Unfortunately, my company has recently transferred me to its office in Da Nang, and I will be moving there at the end of this month. As your centre does not have any branches in that city, I will no longer be able to use my membership.

I would therefore be grateful if you could cancel my membership from 30 June and refund the fee for the remaining seven months. I would prefer the money to be transferred to the bank account from which I made the original payment. If you require any proof of my relocation, I would be happy to provide a letter from my employer.

Thank you for your understanding.

Yours faithfully,
Minh Tran

writing.title: An item left at a conference
writing.prompt:
You recently attended a conference at a hotel, and you think you left something behind there.

Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter

• give details of the conference you attended
• describe the item you lost
• explain how the hotel can contact you and return the item

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Sir or Madam,
outline: Mở thư: nhờ tìm đồ để quên
Đoạn 1: hội nghị nào, ngày, phòng hội trường, chỗ ngồi
Đoạn 2: mô tả đồ (túi laptop màu, nhãn hiệu, đồ bên trong) + vì sao quan trọng
Đoạn 3: cách liên lạc, sẵn sàng trả phí gửi hoặc đến lấy
Kết: Yours faithfully
vocab: I think I left my bag behind.
Please get in touch with me by phone.
I will pay for a courier to return it.
writing.sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to ask for your help in finding an item which I believe I left behind at your hotel last week.

On Thursday 12 October, I attended the Asia Education Technology Conference, which was held in the Lotus Hall on the second floor of your hotel. I sat near the front of the room during the afternoon sessions, and I think I left my bag under my chair when I hurried out to catch a taxi at about 5.30 pm.

It is a black laptop bag with a grey shoulder strap and a small silver logo on the front pocket. Inside are a laptop, a charger and a red notebook containing notes for a report that I have to submit next week. As a result, the bag is extremely important to me.

If the bag has been found, I would be very grateful if you could contact me on 0912 345 678 or by email. I would be happy to collect it in person or to pay for a courier to deliver it to my office.

Thank you in advance for your help.

Yours faithfully,
Minh Tran

writing.title: Asking your manager for flexible hours
writing.prompt:
You would like to take a course which will help you in your job, but the classes take place during working hours.

Write a letter to your manager. In your letter

• describe the course you want to take
• explain how it would benefit your work
• suggest how you could make up the time

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Ms Hoang,
outline: Mở thư: xin điều chỉnh giờ làm để đi học
Đoạn 1: khoá học gì, thời gian (chiều thứ Ba, 10 tuần)
Đoạn 2: lợi ích cho công việc (phân tích dữ liệu, báo cáo nhanh hơn, chia sẻ lại cho nhóm)
Đoạn 3: đề xuất bù giờ (làm sớm, làm thêm thứ Năm), đảm bảo không ảnh hưởng hạn chót
Kết: Yours sincerely / Best regards
vocab: I could make up the time by starting earlier.
The course would benefit the whole team.
chia sẻ những gì học được
I would be happy to share what I learn with colleagues.
This arrangement would not affect any deadlines.
writing.sample:
Dear Ms Hoang,

I am writing to ask whether it would be possible for me to adjust my working hours for a short period so that I can attend a course in data analysis.

The course is run by the City Business School and consists of ten weekly classes, which take place on Tuesday afternoons from 2 pm to 5 pm, starting on 6 March. It covers the use of spreadsheets and data visualisation tools, with practical projects based on real company data.

I believe the course would be of real benefit to our department. At present, I spend many hours each month preparing sales reports manually, and the skills I would learn should allow me to produce them much more quickly and present the results more clearly. I would also be happy to share what I learn with the rest of the team.

To make up the time, I could start work at 7.30 am on Tuesdays and stay an extra two hours on Thursday evenings. I will make sure that this arrangement does not affect any deadlines.

I would be grateful if we could discuss this at your convenience.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Tran

writing.title: A problem in your rented flat
writing.prompt:
Something in the flat you are renting is not working properly.

Write a letter to your landlord. In your letter

• describe the problem
• explain how it is affecting you
• say what you would like your landlord to do

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Mr Lam,
outline: Mở thư: báo máy nước nóng hỏng
Đoạn 1: mô tả sự cố, từ khi nào, đã thử gì
Đoạn 2: ảnh hưởng – tắm nước lạnh, con nhỏ bị cảm, phải sang nhà bạn
Đoạn 3: đề nghị gửi thợ trong tuần, thời gian có mặt ở nhà; hỏi có trừ tiền thuê không
Kết: Best regards / Yours sincerely
vocab: The water heater stopped working last week.
This has caused us considerable inconvenience.
Could you arrange a time for the repair?
writing.sample:
Dear Mr Lam,

I am writing to let you know about a problem with the water heater in the flat at 25 Hoa Binh Street, which I have been renting from you since January.

Last Monday, the heater suddenly stopped producing hot water. The power light still comes on, but the water stays cold however long we wait. I have checked the switch and the fuse box, but this has not solved the problem, and I am worried that there may be an electrical fault.

As you can imagine, this has caused us considerable inconvenience, especially as the weather has turned cold. My family has had to heat water on the stove for washing, and my young son has caught a cold. On some evenings, we have even had to go to my sister's house to have a shower.

I would be very grateful if you could arrange for a qualified technician to repair or replace the heater as soon as possible, ideally within the next few days. I am usually at home after 5 pm on weekdays and all day on Saturday, so please let me know which time suits you.

Best regards,
Minh Tran

writing.title: Noise from your neighbour's renovation
writing.prompt:
Your neighbour, whom you do not know well, is renovating their flat, and the noise is causing you problems.

Write a letter to your neighbour. In your letter

• explain the problem
• describe how it is affecting you
• suggest a solution

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Mrs Pham,
outline: Mở thư: tự giới thiệu, thông cảm việc sửa nhà nhưng tiếng ồn là vấn đề
Đoạn 1: tiếng khoan, đập từ 7h sáng đến tối, cả cuối tuần
Đoạn 2: ảnh hưởng – làm ca đêm cần ngủ ban ngày / mẹ già, em bé
Đoạn 3: đề xuất giờ làm (9h–17h, nghỉ trưa, nghỉ Chủ nhật), báo trước ngày ồn nhất
Kết: Kind regards
vocab: I appreciate that renovations are necessary.
There is loud drilling and hammering every morning.
I work night shifts at the hospital.
Could your builders give advance notice of noisy work?
writing.sample:
Dear Mrs Pham,

I live in flat 804, directly below yours, and I am writing about the renovation work that is currently taking place in your apartment. I appreciate that renovations are sometimes necessary, but I hope we can find a way to reduce the disturbance.

For the past two weeks, there has been loud drilling and hammering from about 7 am until late in the evening, including on Saturdays and Sundays. At times, the noise is so loud that the windows in my living room shake.

This has been particularly difficult for me because I am a nurse and currently work night shifts at the hospital, so I need to sleep during the day. Recently, I have been getting only three or four hours of sleep, and I am finding it hard to concentrate at work. My elderly mother, who lives with me, has also been suffering from headaches.

Would it be possible to ask your builders to work only between 9 am and 5 pm, with a break at lunchtime, and not at all on Sundays? It would also help if they could let me know in advance which days will be the noisiest.

Thank you for your understanding.

Kind regards,
Minh Tran
writing.purpose: Phàn nàn nhẹ nhàng – đề xuất
tags: Phàn nàn nhẹ nhàng – đề xuất

writing.title: Your child will miss a week of school
writing.prompt:
Your child will have to miss a week of school because of a family event.

Write a letter to your child's teacher. In your letter

• explain why your child will be absent
• say what you will do to help your child keep up
• ask for information about the work your child will miss

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Mr Andrews,
outline: Mở thư: xin phép cho con nghỉ học 1 tuần, ngày nào
Đoạn 1: lý do – đám cưới chú ruột ở nước ngoài, cả gia đình phải đi
Đoạn 2: phụ huynh sẽ kèm con đọc sách, làm bài mỗi ngày
Đoạn 3: hỏi bài tập, nội dung sẽ học, có bài kiểm tra không
Kết: Yours sincerely
vocab: My daughter will be absent from school next week.
I want to help her keep up with her classmates.
I do not want her to fall behind.
Tôi sẽ rất cảm kích nếu
I would appreciate it if you could send the homework.
writing.sample:
Dear Mr Andrews,

I am writing to let you know that my daughter, Lan, who is in your Year 5 class, will be absent from school from Monday 9 to Friday 13 December.

My husband's younger brother is getting married in Australia, where he has lived for several years, and the whole family has been invited to the wedding. As this is a very important occasion for our family, and his grandparents are also travelling with us, we have decided to take Lan with us. I am sorry that the trip falls during term time, but the date of the wedding was not something we could change.

I do not want Lan to fall behind while she is away, so I will make sure that she reads every day and practises her maths. She will also keep a diary of the trip in English, which she could share with the class when she returns.

I would appreciate it if you could let me know which topics the class will be covering that week, and whether there is any homework or reading she could do while she is away. I would also like to know whether any tests are planned.

Thank you very much for your help.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Tran

writing.title: Asking a former teacher for a reference
writing.prompt:
You are applying for a scholarship to study abroad, and you need a reference.

Write a letter to a teacher who taught you in the past. In your letter

• remind the teacher who you are
• give details of the scholarship
• explain what you would like the teacher to do

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Dr Nguyen,
outline: Mở thư: nhắc lại mình là ai (lớp, năm, môn), cập nhật hiện tại
Đoạn 1: học bổng gì, ở đâu, ngành gì, hạn nộp
Đoạn 2: nhờ viết thư giới thiệu – nhấn mạnh dự án nghiên cứu đã làm cùng thầy/cô
Đoạn 3: thủ tục (gửi qua email cho tổ chức), hạn; gửi kèm CV, cảm ơn
Kết: Yours sincerely
vocab: có lẽ thầy/cô còn nhớ em
You may remember me from your economics class.
I need a letter of reference for my application.
The deadline for applications is 15 January.
I fully understand if you are too busy.
writing.sample:
Dear Dr Nguyen,

You may remember me from your Environmental Economics class at Hanoi University, which I attended in 2022. I was the student who wrote the final project on plastic recycling in craft villages. Since graduating, I have been working as a research assistant at a non-profit organisation.

I am now applying for the Green Future Scholarship, which would allow me to study for a master's degree in environmental policy at a university in the Netherlands. The scholarship covers tuition fees and living costs for two years, and the deadline for applications is 15 January.

As part of the application, I need two letters of reference, and I would be extremely grateful if you could write one of them. I believe that you know my academic work well, especially the research project I completed under your supervision, which is closely related to the course I hope to study.

If you agree, the scholarship committee will send you an email with a link to an online form. I have attached my CV and a short description of the programme to help you. I fully understand if you are too busy at the moment, so please let me know either way.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Tran

writing.title: Suggesting a trip for your photography club
writing.prompt:
You are a member of a photography club, and you have an idea for a club trip.

Write a letter to the club organiser. In your letter

• describe the trip you would like to suggest
• explain why it would be good for club members
• offer to help with the arrangements

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Mr Duc,
outline: Mở thư: đề xuất chuyến đi chụp ảnh cho CLB
Đoạn 1: đi đâu (Mộc Châu mùa hoa mận), khi nào, bao lâu, di chuyển thế nào
Đoạn 2: lợi ích – chụp phong cảnh, bình minh, đời sống bản làng; thành viên mới làm quen; triển lãm sau chuyến đi
Đoạn 3: đề nghị giúp – liên hệ homestay, xe; khảo sát thành viên

writing.sample:
Dear Mr Duc,

I hope you are well. I am writing to put forward an idea for a club trip, which I think many members would enjoy.

I would like to suggest a weekend trip to Moc Chau in late January, when the plum trees are in blossom. We could hire a minibus and leave Hanoi early on Saturday morning, spend one night at a homestay in a local village, and return on Sunday evening. I estimate that the total cost, including transport, food and accommodation, would be around 1,200,000 dong per person.

I believe the trip would be valuable for several reasons. The hills, the tea plantations and the early-morning mist would give us excellent opportunities for landscape photography, while the village would allow members to practise portrait and street photography. It would also help our newer members to get to know everyone, as at present we rarely meet outside our monthly meetings. Afterwards, we could hold a small exhibition of the best photos.

If you like the idea, I would be happy to take care of the arrangements, such as contacting the homestay and the bus company, and sending a short survey to members to find out who would like to join.

Best regards,
Minh Tran

Dear Mr Clarke,

writing.sample:
Dear Mr Clarke,

I am writing to suggest a small change to our office which I believe would make a real difference to the way our team works.

As you know, our department moved into an open-plan office last spring. While this has improved communication, the noise level is often very high, especially in the mornings when several colleagues are on the phone at the same time. Many of us find it difficult to concentrate on detailed tasks, such as checking contracts, and customers have sometimes complained that they cannot hear us clearly during calls.

My suggestion is to turn the small storage room next to the kitchen into a quiet room. Most of the boxes stored there are old files that could be moved to the basement. The room could be furnished with two desks and a phone, and staff could book it online for an hour at a time, either for focused work or for important calls. The cost would be minimal.

I am confident that this would increase productivity and reduce stress, and it would also make our calls with clients sound more professional. Perhaps we could try the idea for a trial period of one month and then ask the team for feedback.

Best regards,
Minh Tran

Dear Mrs Wilson,

I would like to thank you for allowing my family to stay in your beautiful house in Brighton last week. We thoroughly enjoyed our holiday there.

The house was even better than it looked in the photographs. The children loved waking up to the view of the sea, and the kitchen was so well equipped that we were able to cook most of our meals ourselves. We also followed your advice and visited the small fish restaurant at the end of the pier, which was excellent.

Unfortunately, I must also apologise for an accident that happened on our last evening. While I was cleaning the living room, I accidentally knocked the blue ceramic vase off the shelf by the window, and it broke into several pieces. I have kept the pieces in a box in the cupboard under the stairs. I feel terrible about this, especially as the vase looked as if it might have been special to you.

I would like to cover the cost of a replacement or a repair. Please let me know how much it would cost and how you would like me to pay, and I will send the money immediately.

Kind regards,
Minh Tran

writing.prompt:

Dear Anna,
outline: Mở thư: vui khi bạn muốn sang chơi

Đoạn 2: kế hoạch cùng nhau (phố cổ, ẩm thực đường phố, vịnh Hạ Long)

writing.sample:
Dear Anna,

Thanks so much for your email. I was thrilled to hear that you're finally thinking of coming to Vietnam!

I think the best time for you to visit would be in late March or April. At that time of year, the weather in Hanoi is warm but not too hot, and it hardly ever rains. You'd also avoid the Tet holiday, when lots of shops and restaurants close and transport is very crowded.

There are so many things we could do together. We could spend a day wandering around the Old Quarter and the lake, and I'd love to take you on an evening street food tour – you have to try bun cha and egg coffee! If you have a week, we could also take a two-day trip to Ha Long Bay and sleep on a boat.

A couple of tips: check the visa rules before you book your flight, and download a ride-hailing app, as it's much cheaper and easier than taking taxis from the street. Bring comfortable shoes too, because we'll be doing a lot of walking.

Let me know your dates as soon as you can. I can't wait to see you!

Love,
Linh

writing.sample:
Dear Tom,

I just wanted to say a huge thank you for looking after Miu while I was away. I really can't thank you enough!

When I got home, she was happy and healthy, and the flat was spotless. I know how busy you've been at work recently, so it was really kind of you to come round twice a day to feed her and play with her. It meant I could relax on holiday, because I knew she was in good hands.

The trip to Da Lat was wonderful. The weather was cool and fresh, which was a nice change from the heat here, and we spent most of our time walking through the pine forests and visiting little coffee farms. It rained heavily one afternoon, but we just sat in a café by the lake and watched the storm. I've brought you back a bag of local coffee beans – I hope you like them.

I'd love to return the favour. Let me treat you to dinner next weekend at that new Korean restaurant you mentioned. And if you ever need someone to water your plants while you're away, just let me know.

Best wishes,
Linh

Dear Mai,

I'm so sorry I missed your birthday party on Saturday. I know I'd promised to be there, and I feel awful that I let you down, especially as it was your 25th.

I really want to explain what happened. Out of the blue, my mum started having terrible stomach pains on Saturday afternoon, and we had to rush her to hospital. The doctors said it was appendicitis, so she had an operation that evening. I spent the whole night at the hospital with her, and in all the panic, I forgot to charge my phone, so I couldn't even call you. She's recovering well now, thank goodness, and should be home in a few days.

I've seen the photos online, and it looks like everyone had a fantastic time. The cake looked amazing!

Please let me make it up to you. How about I take you out for dinner next Friday at that Italian place you love, and then we could go and see a film? I've also got a small present for you, which I'll bring along.

I hope you can forgive me.

Lots of love,
Linh

Dear Ben,

Congratulations on getting a place at Hanoi University! I'm so excited that you'll be living in my city for a whole year.

You asked about accommodation. My advice would be to stay in the university dormitory for your first term. It's cheap and safe, and it's the easiest way to make friends. After that, you could share a flat with some classmates near the campus. Try to avoid renting in the city centre, though, as it's much more expensive and the traffic is terrible.

As for what to bring, it's worth bringing your own laptop, as electronics aren't much cheaper here, and don't forget copies of your passport and university documents. If you take any regular medicine, bring enough for a few months. Lots of people think Hanoi is hot all year round, but it can get quite cold in January, so pack a warm jacket too.

When you arrive, I'll pick you up from the airport and help you buy a local SIM card and open a bank account. Then, once you've settled in, I'll show you around my favourite places.

See you soon!

Linh

Dear Sarah,

Sorry I haven't written for ages – things have been so busy here! I've got some exciting news: I've just started a new job as a marketing assistant at a beach resort in Da Nang.

I'm mainly in charge of the resort's website and social media accounts, so I spend a lot of my time taking photos, writing posts and replying to messages from guests. I also help to organise special events, such as weddings and music nights on the beach. Last weekend, we had a concert for over three hundred people, which was exhausting but great fun.

What I love most about the job is that every day is different. My colleagues are really friendly, and my manager is giving me lots of opportunities to learn new skills, like video editing. It's also very rewarding to read the lovely comments that guests leave after their stay. And of course, I can see the sea from my office window!

Why don't you come and visit me during your summer holiday? There's plenty of room in my new flat, and I could show you the best beaches and seafood restaurants in the city.

Take care, and write back soon!

Linh

The new place is much bigger and brighter than my current one, and it has a balcony where I can grow some plants. The only problem is that it's on the fifth floor, and there's no lift, which brings me to the reason I'm writing.

I was wondering if you could give me a hand on moving day, which will be Saturday 15 March. I've booked a small van for the morning, but I really need someone strong to help me carry the heavy furniture, especially my wardrobe and the washing machine, up the stairs. If you're free, we could start at about 8 am, and we should be finished by lunchtime. You're also much better at putting furniture together than I am, so your help with my new bed would be very welcome!

To say thank you, I'll cook you a big dinner that evening, and of course you'll be the guest of honour at my housewarming party.

Cheers,

Dear Lucy,

How are things with you? I hope you're settling into your new flat. I'm writing because I've just finished a book that I think you'd really enjoy, and I couldn't wait to tell you about it.

It's called The Night Market, and it's a novel about a young woman who gives up her office job in London and opens a small food stall at a night market in Taipei. I won't tell you too much about the plot, but it's about her struggle to make the business work, the unusual friends she makes along the way, and a family secret that she discovers.

I loved it because the characters feel completely real, and the writer describes the food so vividly that you can almost smell it. It's funny in places and quite moving in others, and the chapters are short, so it's a real page-turner. I honestly couldn't put it down until two o'clock in the morning!

I think it would be right up your street, since you love travelling and cooking, and like the main character, you've just made a big change in your life. If you like, I can lend you my copy when we meet next week.

Love,
Linh

writing.title: Helping a friend choose between two jobs
writing.prompt:

Dear David,
outline: Mở thư: chúc mừng có 2 lời mời làm việc
Đoạn 1: nhắc lại 2 lựa chọn (công ty lớn lương cao nhưng xa, ít linh hoạt vs startup lương thấp hơn nhưng học nhiều)
Đoạn 2: lời khuyên – chọn startup
Đoạn 3: lý do – bạn thích thử thách, còn trẻ, cơ hội học nhanh; nhưng hỏi kỹ hợp đồng; đề nghị gọi điện nói chuyện
Kết: Good luck
vocab: What great news about the job offers!
I can see why you're in a dilemma.

It would be better for your career in the long run.
writing.sample:
Dear David,

What great news about the job offers! You must be really proud of yourself – it shows how much employers value your skills.

I can see why you're in a dilemma. On the one hand, the bank is offering you a higher salary, a pension and a lot of security, but it would mean a ninety-minute commute every day and a fairly strict routine. On the other hand, the start-up pays less, but the office is near your home, the hours are flexible, and you'd be working on new apps from day one.

If I were you, I'd take the job at the start-up. You've always told me how much you enjoy solving problems and trying new things, and in a small company you'd get much more responsibility and learn far more quickly. You're young and don't have a family to support yet, so this is the perfect time to take a risk. Experience like that would probably be better for your career in the long run, even if it isn't as well paid at first.

That said, do ask them some questions about their funding and your contract before you sign anything. Why don't we have a chat on the phone this weekend?

Good luck!

Linh
